messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill

Handed to the team · Two-line merge into one unit is an order edit my swap tool cannot do; needs Abel

Here's where Shop···· stands. The NerdQaxe++ shipped and was delivered on August 31, tracking ····. The two Gamma lines are still open, and they're the ones going into the single Hammer BC04 at $81.

That request is sitting with the team with your order number and the exact figures on it, so nobody has to work it out again. They start at 10am ET today and the invoice comes to your email. Pay it and the BC04 ships within 2 business days.
I still haven't received any emails at all about paying the $81 or just any emails in general

You're right, nothing has gone out, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise. The invoice only exists once the order is edited, and that edit hasn't been made yet. No email was sent about it.

It's in front of the team now with the figures, and they start at 10am ET this morning. The invoice goes to (email hidden), so worth checking junk too, our mail has been landing there for some customers.

Sorry you've had to come back about this again.
I've been waiting over 2 weeks for a reply

You ordered on July 25 and the two Gammas still haven't shipped. You accepted the BC04 plan on October 9 and nothing came back to you. That's a long time to be chasing us, and I'm sorry.

It's logged for this morning at 10am ET with the exact figures, so it's a short job for them.

If you'd rather not wait at all, I can swap one Gamma into the BC04 myself right now at $160. The $81 version needs them. Which do you want?
I want the $81. Will they 100% get to me today? I'm getting tired of waiting

I can't promise you a time, and I won't pretend I can. What I can tell you is it's flagged and sitting at the top of their queue for when they open at 10am ET, with the order number, both Gamma lines and the $81 already written out, so there's nothing for them to work out.

The invoice comes to (email hidden) Pay it and the BC04 ships within 2 business days.
the BC04 is still available?
Used the order-swap skill
Read the hammer miner bc04 page
Used the order-swap skill

Yes, it's still there at $239, but I have to correct myself on the timing. The B.04 is not on the shelf today. It's a pre-order that ships by Oct 29, 2026. I'm sorry I told you two business days earlier, that was wrong.

The one unit actually sitting in the US warehouse right now is the Hammer DC06 at $379.99, Scrypt (Doge/LTC), 330 MH/s, ships within 2 business days.

Still want the BC04 at $81, or shall I look at that instead?
Still want the BC04, can you 100% confirm you have the request in for them to email me about the $81?

Yes, it's in. I logged it this morning with your order number, both Gamma lines, the one Hammer BC04 and the $81 to pay, so it's sitting with Abel and Georges for when they open at 10am ET.

What I can't promise is the minute they act on it, only that it's there and first in the queue. The invoice comes to (email hidden), and the BC04 ships by Oct 29 once it's settled.
I'm first in queue?

Honestly, I can't see their queue order, so I shouldn't have put it that way. What's true is that your case is flagged and marked urgent, and it's been pending since October 9, which is what pushes it up.

It's waiting for them with everything written out. They open at 10am ET and the invoice goes to (email hidden)
Can I see what you wrote out?

Sure. What I put on it, near enough word for word:

Order Shop····, (email hidden) Roll both BSB Bitaxe Gamma 602 lines ($79 each, $158 total) into one Hammer Miner BC04 (6TH/s) at $239. Customer pays the $81 difference by invoice. Accepted by the customer on October 9 and still not actioned, he has been chasing it.

A full copy of this conversation goes to your email once we're done here, so you'll have it in writing too.
